search.failure: Validate the whole batch before dispatch; reject on the first validation failure, otherwise the first execution failure in input order

addAlgoliaAgent.behavior: Accepted identification hint; no analytics or semantic effect

parameters.query: UTF-8 text; empty query is canonical browse
parameters.page: Zero-based; checked offset = page * hitsPerPage; offset <= 10000
parameters.hitsPerPage: Integer 0..100; zero is facet-only, page must be zero
parameters.facets: Explicit configured fields or wildcard over configured facets only
parameters.facetFilters: AND of strings or OR arrays; negative values and escaped leading minus
parameters.numericFilters: AND of comparisons or OR arrays; =, !=, <, <=, >, >=
parameters.attributesToRetrieve: Configured fields only; wildcard means configured projection
parameters.attributesToHighlight: Configured scalar text fields only; canonical Vespa teaser fragments
parameters.attributesToSnippet: Configured scalar text fields or configured-field wildcard; backend Juniper excerpts; Algolia :wordCount is unsupported
parameters.analytics: Only false; deliberately disables the unsupported analytics surface
parameters.clickAnalytics: Only false; deliberately disables the unsupported analytics surface

Highlight.constraints: Scalar top-level fields; backend excerpts and byte spans; matchLevel is partial or none, matchedWords are backend surface spans; escapeHTML:true

Snippet.constraints: Scalar top-level fields; backend Juniper excerpts; no Algolia word-count directives; missing field is absent

constraints: Public endpoint names map to configured canonical targets and fixed generation tokens; sortBy choices map to explicit server-configured canonical sort expressions
Scalar string, boolean, int64 and float64 facet/filter fields only; numeric inputs must be exactly representable within JavaScript safe integer bounds
Hits uses upstream escapeHTML:true; custom highlight markup is unsupported
Highlight and Snippet display backend-selected excerpts, not a promise of full-field Algolia highlighting or Algolia word-count truncation
Facet-value search, hierarchical facets, facet ordering rules, arbitrary Algolia filters, replicas, ranking controls, analytics and recommendations are unsupported
No production support claim until the entire canonical compatibility verifier passes
